The only shown test change (`apps/web/playwright/webhook.e2e.ts`) updates an assertion from `destinationCalendar: null` to `destinationCalendar: []`, which validates payload shape but does not exercise the GoogleCalendarService credential-based calendar selection or multi-destination behavior. This is a specific, diff-grounded missing-test/coverage concern rather than a directly verifiable functional defect.
